```elixir title="Elixir"

result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def alpha():\n    pass\n\ndef beta():\n    pass\n\ndef gamma():\n    pass\n\ndef delta():\n    pass\n", config_value)
IO.inspect(result.language)
```
